stories.title: Motorbikes and mountains: photographing the 2026 Tour de France – photo essay
stories.extract:
Twenty Tours de France. It seems faintly ridiculous when I write it down. My first was the year Lance Armstrong’s carefully constructed empire was beginning to wobble. I photographed him circling the Champs-Élysées with a film SLR, blissfully unaware that neither film cameras nor Armstrong’s reputation would age particularly well.
Today I’m back where it all began, sitting outside a cafe a stone’s throw from the Place de la Concorde nursing a café crème while Paris carries on entirely oblivious.

stories.title: Richard Thompson Readies 20th Solo Album
stories.summary: A raucous bar-rock ditty titled “Cocaine Walking, Booze Talking” leads Hippies Thugs, and Heroes
stories.extract:
Richard Thompson is readying the 20th solo studio album of his nearly six-decade career. The prolific and influential British guitarist will share Hippies, Thugs, and Heroes on October 16 via New West. His follow-up to 2024’s Ship to Shore is led by a raucous bar-rock ditty appropriately titled “Cocaine Walking, Booze Talking.” Listen below.
“It’s so much fun to mess around at home and disappear down into the basement for hours at a time,” Thompson said of demoing the album in a press statement.
